notes.title: FirstQueen1 NEXT strategy tips
notes.content:
"Fight with more friendly soldiers against strong enemies"
This is the real thrill of this work.

Therefore, the number of soldiers as well as strong troops is important.
The basic strategy is to form a unit with more soldiers than the enemy unit and fight.

When dealing with a strong enemy unit, it is a good idea to place it next to the map where multiple units are fighting in both partial and two-unit battles, and change reinforcements in a pinch.

The fallen character will not come back to life.
Therefore, "increasing allies" is more important than strengthening allies. Besides, if you can utilize equipment and items, you can proceed with the capture in an advantageous way.

Enemies may turn over as a way to increase their allies.
To do so, you must first defeat the leader who has a character who turns over (usually an enemy soldier character). Operate the character well to surround and defeat the leader.


------------------ Tips on how to fight -------------------------

1. About strong enemies
・ Large soldier
Enclose it with summons as much as possible, and quickly evacuate and recover the soldiers who are in a pinch.
・ Red skeleton
The magic is powerful, but you can return it to a soldier with the "Resurrection Stone".
・ Red crow
Because it is vulnerable to arrows, let's repel it with archers such as Centaurs.

2. About "difficulty"
In particular, hordes await the two hills of Resinp and Luton.
Instead of forcing the hills, you can "detour" until you are ready.

3. About "the spring of the enemy"
There are no enemy gushes on the map where your army is camping.
* It is a good idea to occupy the "Salas Mountain Road" at an early stage (camp your troops).

4. About level up
To level up, let's train by defeating monsters by going in and out of the camp without moving the map.
As time goes by in and out of the map, enemies will march more and more. Strong enemies will also appear.
* You can easily raise the level by equipping the "Rainbow Shield" possessed by Goincho's unit and going to the "Benick's Graveyard".
* If too much time passes, powerful enemy reinforcements will be generated and it will be difficult to attack, and the battle situation will change over time.


------------------ Recommended items ------------------------

Various summon items such as mud dolls
Various medicines that increase life and parameters
In a turbulent battle, the magic and items (Himaya) of "Sleep Paralysis" are effective.

* Continuous summon item.
・ Dog whistle 2800 points, where to get it, Salisbury Village
=> Summon a wolf. Great effect with beastmaster equipment

・ Elven crown 5500 points, where to get it, Benic Castle
=> Summon an angel when equipped by King Elf (no item consumption)
=> When equipped by the Elf Prince, multiple spells can be used (gold binding is recommended)


------------------ Recommended characters ------------------------

Alan
You can easily defeat the big octopus, the boss in the early stages.
At the beginning of the game, Constantine is surrounded by enemies, but if you withdraw immediately after moving the map, you can reach the onlay without being caught by allies, and you can join Alain's troops.

magician
You can change classes by sending a monk to Benick's castle alone.
If you go to the church in the village of Richmond ...
The recommended magic is "sleep paralysis"
It is effective in hills and other turbulent battles.
"Meteor" is difficult to guess, but it is quite effective for large giants.

notes.title: Game update notice
notes.content:
I made it with the latest version of SteamSDK 149 released on the 14th, but it seems that it still does not connect to the inventory server.
The game can proceed, so please continue to enjoy.

〇Fixed some bugs.
1. If you switch to the application with Alt tab after switching to the full screen with the Esc key, the drawing will freeze.
The game itself is in progress, and if you press the Esc key again to return to the window, the drawing will be normal, but I think it is frozen.
2. System Settings (Lance Icon)
Automatic Critical Change "Yes" and "No" were the opposite
"Yes" 
"No" 
=>
"No" 
"Yes"

〇Added some features.
1. When there is a return mark in the upper right corner of the screen, right click the mouse to return.
2.The character can be moved with the WASD key.
  You can use the WASD key to move the character by pressing the W key on the game screen.
  Press the W key on the camp screen to return the WASD key to its original function.
For details, click the book icon on the game screen to see the manual.
